source: Loving you is worth any fate, even being torn apart.
zh: 和你相爱，粉身碎骨也值得。
sentence_translations.note: Risk 对 PanaW 的评论给出的固定中文译文；用于闪哲在 Chapter 007 的原句。

source: If ever should I taste of love’s sweet savor,
All things I shall forsake and seek no more the Eternal Gate.
zh: 若有朝品尝爱情的滋味，
我将舍弃万物，不再奔往永恒之门。
sentence_translations.note: Risk 给出的格兰诗句固定中文译文；凡两行原句出现时均保持该表述。

source: “Oh!” Tetsu was rather amused. “If that’s how it is, then take my soul. Do you want it? It’s yours. I won’t go to the Eternal Gate; it belongs to you. Take my soul. You’re my only god.”
zh: “哦！”闪哲反而觉得很有意思：“既然如此，将我的灵魂取走吧，想要吗？给你，不去永恒之门，归你了。将我灵魂取去，你是我唯一的神。”
sentence_translations.note: Risk reply translating Tetsu's Chapter 008 confession; preserve the supplied wording as one source paragraph.

source: Thou art an emissary from far-flung realms,
The keeper of the Eternal Gate,
When descends the tide of frost that sweeps across the ages,
Rendering all between heaven and earth to naught,
Across the boundless ice I see thee approach, come to bear me away.
But whither could we possibly fly?
Within this dark, we can but kindle a fire of the soul,
And cling to one another till dawn breaks.
zh: 当席卷岁月的寒潮来到之时，
你在无垠的冰面上朝我走来，带我离开。
只能在当下生起灵魂之火
sentence_translations.note: Risk 在 Chapter 015 评论中给出的九行诗官方中文版本；按连续诗节逐行保护。
